aiDm.title: AI Dungeon Master
aiDm.intro: Experimental. A server admin must enable server-side AI and set the provider + API key in the AI console for any of this to take effect; until then, saving here returns a clear "disabled" message. This page carries only the settings that vary per table — mode, budget, and steering.
aiDm.inheritedNotice: Using the server-wide defaults for <0>{{fields}}</0>. This campaign hasn't been configured yet, so it follows the server default and moves when an admin changes it. Saving any setting below keeps the current values and stops following.

off.label: Off
off.blurb: No AI participation. The seat is idle — nothing is proposed or narrated.

co_dm.label: Co-DM (assist)
co_dm.blurb: Asks. The AI only proposes — every draft lands in your approval queue, and nothing changes until a human DM accepts or rejects it. The AI never writes to canon directly. Recommended.

driver.label: Driver
driver.blurb: Acts. The AI holds the DM seat and runs the session directly — it narrates, rolls dice, applies HP and conditions, awards XP, advances turns, creates an encounter when the scene calls for one (always as DM-only prep, hidden until you reveal it), reveals map regions, and jots table notes within the budget you set. Canon edits (new NPCs, quests, locations) still become proposals for your review. Requires the experimental server flag, a positive token budget, and a configured provider.

narrationLanguage.body: Governs AI-generated narration from the Driver, co-DM drafts, and Scribe recaps. This is separate from your personal UI language in Preferences.
narrationLanguage.label: Campaign narration language

provider.scopeNoteCampaign: This campaign overrides the server default below.
provider.scopeNoteServer: Inherited from the server default set by your server admin.
provider.missingDetail: The provider settings exist, but no usable credential is available. Ask the server admin to set a key or environment credential.
provider.noneConfigured: No AI provider configured — Campfire will use its built-in no-op scaffold, so Driver cannot narrate a live session. Ask your server admin to set one in the AI console, or set a campaign-specific override below.
provider.advancedToggle: Advanced: override provider for this campaign
provider.advancedIntro: Optional. Most campaigns leave this blank and use the server default. Set a provider here to override it for this table only (a key is optional — a keyless override still uses the server key with the server's endpoint).

budget.body: A hard token cap. Turns stop once it's reached — a positive budget is required to run Driver mode.
budget.label: Token budget

instructions.body: DM-only persona / house rules for the AI. Never shown to players — this is where plot secrets can live.
instructions.placeholder: e.g. Be terse and grim. Never reveal the traitor's identity until Act 3.

tableStyle.body: Asks the AI to narrate a certain way. Each choice adds a line of guidance to its prompt — it steers voice and pacing, it does not change what is true, and a model can ignore it. Leave an axis on Default to say nothing about it.

npcDepth.light: Light — a name and a trait

comprehension.body: Asks the AI to structure narration for readability — a different axis from table style, above. On every setting the AI already chunks narration into short beats, closes each turn with "What changed" then "What can you do", offers 2-4 suggested actions alongside free-form input (never instead of it), and answers a Simplify/Recap/Explain request from a player. These dropdowns fine-tune that baseline; leaving an axis on Default states no extra preference.

paragraphLength.standard: Standard — a few sentences per beat

sensoryIntensity.minimal: Minimal — only what a player needs to act
sensoryIntensity.standard: Standard — a moderate amount of detail
